analyzed_vuln.description: In SortByPTypeProcess::Execute, face index counts are trusted without validation. The loop at line ~189 does `++aiNumPerPType[pFirstFace->mNumIndices - 1]` when `mNumIndices <= 3`. If a malformed mesh has a face with `mNumIndices == 0`, this underflows to index `UINT_MAX`, causing an out-of-bounds write to the 4-element stack array `aiNumPerPType` (wild write/SEGV). Crash is observed at this write site.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Fuzzer harness calls `Importer::ReadFileFromMemory(..., aiProcessPreset_TargetRealtime_Quality, ...)`, which enables post-processing including SortByPTypeProcess. A parsed scene must contain at least one mesh with mixed primitive types (so this code path runs) and at least one face with `mNumIndices == 0`. That malformed face reaches SortByPTypeProcess::Execute and triggers the OOB write via `mNumIndices - 1` indexing.
